Name: Mothman
Author: aviroen
Description:
[size=6]My Entry for [url=https://discord.com/channels/137344473976799233/1292662149516103751]Stardew's Spirit's Eve Event[/url] 2024
[/size]
Ever wanted a Romanceable Mothman?

Art is heavily inspired by [url=https://juliancallos.tumblr.com/post/181410572366/merry-christmas-from-the-mothman]Julian Callos[/url]

[quote][size=6]Quick and Dirty Walkthrough:[/size]
[spoiler]
0 Heart: FALL 26 IN THE TOWN, ANYTIME

2 Heart: IN THE TOWN, ANYTIME, MUST HAVE WATCHED PREVIOUS

4 Heart: ON THE BEACH, ANYTIME, MUST HAVE WATCHED PREVIOUS

6 Heart: IN THE SEWERS, ANYTIME, MUST HAVE 6 HEARTS WITH KROBUS AS WELL, MUST HAVE WATCHED PREVIOUS

8 Heart: IN THE TOWN, BETWEEN 8PM AND 2AM, MUST HAVE 8 HEARTS WITH KROBUS AS WELL, MUST HAVE WATCHED PREVIOUS

10 Heart: IN THE SEWERS, MUST BE FEMALE, MUST HAVE 8 HEARTS WITH KROBUS, MUST HAVE WATCHED PREVIOUS

10 Heart PART 2: IN THE SEWER, 5-6 DAYS AFTER SEEING THE PREVIOUS EVENT

12 Heart: MARRIED, OBVIOUSLY, IN THE TOWN, MUST HAVE WATCHED 10 HEART PART 2

14 Heart: ON THE BEACH, MUST HAVE WATCHED PREVIOUS
[/spoiler][/quote]

Maybe I'll do a fancier header image.

[quote][size=6]Quick and dirty FAQ[/size]
[size=5]Why are they only romanceable to women?
[/size][s]Because this was originally an idea born from a twitter handle. Also I don't make the rules I just follow them.
[/s]1.0.2 now romanceable to all genders.

[size=5]Why is everything in Pig Latin?[/size]
Dwarvish wouldn't make sense because they get along with Krobus, and normal speech wouldn't make sense either since they cannot communicate with humans.

[size=5]Do you plan to add more content?[/size]
Honestly I don't know, this was just something to relieve my stress, [s]I'll think about it.
[/s]No more content to be added unless I plan to turn this modpage into a full on cryptid expansion, we'll see.

[size=5]What do the Configs Mean? GMCM suggested[/size]
"Judge Mode" will remove all of the requirements for the heart events, as well as unlocking Mothman day 1. The heart events will still play out in order.
"English" will change all of the Pig Latin into plain English for accessibility purposes.[/quote]

Downloads.Description:
8 heart events, some Krobus flavor text, mostly speaks in Pig Latin and clicks. Doesn't start speaking Pig Latin until 10 heart pt 2.
Sprites In Detail not optional to emphasize BIG
SiDFix.dll included (courtesy of Mushymato)
